records_written_breakdown.note: the original v1 publication count: every jsonl/ row plus every splits_v2/ pointer row (945, including the 2 quarantined cross-split duplicates). It counts pointers, not distinct records: a finding and its exploit/patch rows share an id, and each split row points back at a jsonl row. Distinct canonical ids are 722 findings+negatives; jsonl/ holds 953 rows; derived/ holds 722 derived records. This key is kept as the historical publish figure because audit_pre_upgrade.py pins it (v1_manifest_records_written).
